model_contract.dense_block: one per MoE layer independent of PP
model_contract.data: same full seeded input and target tensors across topologies, partitioned by stage-data index
model_contract.loss: global MSE mean: local MSE/stageWorld; SUM replica gradient synchronization

verification.negative: wrong SumPartials backward identity must fail gradient while forward passes
verification.checks: outputs, raw input/PP boundary gradients, all synced parameter gradients, parameters, AdamW state; common-reference input/parameter count/update fingerprints across topologies

measurement.run_order: predeclared interleaved strength/node order; before/after controls; no outcome selection
measurement.metrics: All online epoch outputs union, observed FP including invalid profiles, planned exact denominators fixed; paper-text replay separate; rejected/incomplete retained; per topology/node/strength/stage reports; measured latency increase and throughput drop, do not label delays as paper percentages.

budget.stop: verification failure, source mismatch, shared identity loss, engineering timeout/failure or suite deadline; cleanup only owned containers and preserve evidence
